verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.subtitle: Confirm this address to finish setting up your account.
verify.doneBody: {{email}} is confirmed. You can now create API tokens, invite people and create organizations.
verify.missingBody: Open the full link from the email, or sign in and send a new one.
verify.invalid: This link does not work any more
verify.invalidBody: It expired, was already used, or a newer link replaced it. Sign in and send a new one from the banner.
verify.note: The link works once and expires 24 hours after it was sent.

banner.title: Confirm your email address
banner.bodyEmail: We sent a link to {{email}}. Until you open it you can run evaluations, but not create API tokens, invite people or create organizations.
banner.bodyLog: This server does not send email. Check with your admin: the link for {{email}} is in the server log. Until you open it you can run evaluations, but not create API tokens, invite people or create organizations.
banner.sentEmail: A new link is on its way to {{email}}.
banner.sentLog: A new link is in the server log. Check with your admin.

signup.allowlistOnly: Sign up here with an address at {{domains}}. Other addresses need an invitation.
signup.verifyEmail: We will email you a link to confirm your address.
signup.verifyLog: Your server admin passes on the link that confirms your address.

locked: Confirm your email first: open the link we sent you, or send a new one from the banner at the top of the page.

admin.title: Who can sign up
admin.subtitle: Applies to the web sign-up page and GitHub sign-in. Invitations always work, except when sign-up is closed.

modeHelp.invite: Only people an organization admin invites can create an account.
modeHelp.allowlist: Invited people, plus anyone with an address at the domains below. Each gets an organization of their own.
modeHelp.open: Anyone with an email address can create an account and an organization. Use only for a public service.
modeHelp.closed: Nobody signs up on the web. Accounts come from bifrost-bench user create on the server.

admin.domainsHint: One per line or comma separated, such as acme.com. Exact match: eu.acme.com is a separate domain.
admin.saved: Saved. New sign-ups follow this setting now.
admin.sourceAdmin: Set here by {{who}} {{when}}. The server config says {{mode}}.
admin.sourceConfig: From the server config (HEIMDALL_SIGNUP and HEIMDALL_SIGNUP_DOMAINS).
admin.deliveryLog: No mail sender is set: verification links go to the server log. Pass them on, or run bifrost-bench user verify -email <address> on the server.
admin.confirmOpen: Let anyone on the internet create an account here?
admin.loadFailed: Could not load the sign-up setting: {{message}}
